questions.question: Work out 25 + 15 × 4 and explain the order you used.
questions.expected_answer: Multiply first: 15 × 4 = 60. Then add: 25 + 60 = 85. Multiplication is done before addition.

questions.question: The class bus trip costs R1 200. The school pays R450 and the rest is shared by 5 groups. Write a number sentence and work out how much each group pays.
questions.expected_answer: (1 200 − 450) ÷ 5. Brackets first: 1 200 − 450 = 750. Then 750 ÷ 5 = 150. Each group pays R150.

questions.question: A family buys 3 tickets at R125 and 2 tickets at R85 and pays with R600. Write one number sentence for the change and work it out.
questions.expected_answer: 600 − (3 × 125 + 2 × 85). Inside the brackets: 375 + 170 = 545. Then 600 − 545 = 55. The change is R55.
